g.text: Polypharmacy Adverse Drug Event (ADE) Cohort Pipeline (ed_non_opioid)
Phase 3: Acute Exposure Horizon & Feature Engineering

text.tspan: (All-Payer Encounters, HCG Detail Codes, ICD-10 Positions 1–10)
(Adjudicated Dispenses, NDC to Generic RxNorm, Days Supply)
Target Codes: P51b (ER), O11 (ER Services), P33 (Outpatient Observation)
Strictly drops any patient with ANY opioid ICD-10 code
(F11.* or T40.*) across all 10 diagnosis columns in study year
Guarantees 100% mutual exclusivity with opioid cohort
Filter 1: ED Utilization Cap (< 7 ED Visits/Year)
Filter 2: Proximal Drug Exposure Window (1–21 Days Pre-ED)
• Patient must have active pharmacy dispensing 1–21 days prior
21-day window captures ~90.5% of all acute ADE time-to-onset distributions
• STRICTLY PURGES all prescriptions dispensed on Day 0 (t₀)
• Clinical Rationale: Day 0 claims represent discharge meds
(e.g., antiemetics, antibiotics, analgesics) prescribed AFTER the visit
• Beers Criteria High-Risk Medications in Older Adults
• Tabular Counts & Claims-Density Bins (P25/P50/P95) → Tree Feature Matrix
• bupaR Process Flows, DTW Clusters & FP-Growth Rules → Dashboard Only
• Covered APCD members in same partition year
• Zero qualifying ED visits in study year
Controls assigned earliest non-ED medical claim date

g.text: Asserts EXACTLY ONE index date per person-year

text.tspan: Asserts EXACTLY ONE index date per person-year
Suppresses n ≤ 10 cell counts per CMS/VHI privacy policy
• Cases + 5:1 Controls with Locked Pre-Index Whitelist
